name: CookieNod
author: cookienod

sections.description:
CookieNod is a simple, lightweight cookie consent notice plugin for WordPress. It displays a non-intrusive cookie banner at the top or bottom of your website, or as a center modal.

Features:

  • Simple cookie consent banner
  • Three display positions: bottom banner, top banner, or center modal
  • Light and dark themes
  • Customizable message, button text, and category labels
  • Full layout control: Full width or Boxed with custom width settings
  • Advanced Custom CSS for personalized styling (v1.0.3)
  • Works without API key for basic functionality

CookieNod Extended

Need more than a simple cookie banner?

CookieNod Extended is a free Cookie Consent Management System for WordPress with automatic cookie scanning, script blocking, consent logging, Google Consent Mode, and other advanced privacy and compliance features.

Learn more: CookieNod Extended
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “CookieNod”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Configure settings under Settings > CookieNod
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No, the core plugin works without an API key. However, an API key can be used to unlock premium plans (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) which provide higher page scanning limits, advanced reporting, and priority support.

Can I customize the banner appearance?

Yes, you can choose between light/dark themes, banner position (top, bottom, or center modal), and layout styles (Full Width or Boxed with custom width).

Can I use my own CSS to style the banner?

Yes, the plugin includes an Advanced Custom CSS editor in the settings. This allows you to apply personalized styles to the banner and its elements without modifying the plugin files.

How do users manage their cookie preferences?

When users click the “Customize” button on the banner, a Preference Center opens. You can customize the title and the names of the cookie categories (e.g., Necessary, Analytics) to match your brand’s terminology.

Why is there an API key automatically generated?

The plugin automatically generates a unique Site ID (API Key) upon activation. This identifier allows the plugin to synchronize detected cookies and verify your plan level without requiring you to manually create an account or enter a key for basic functionality.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Added Custom CSS feature for banner styling.
  • Implemented Plan-Based Freemium model (Free, Basic, Pro, Enterprise).
  • Added API key field to settings for unlocking premium features.
  • Enabled full customization of banner texts, including categories and preference center labels.
  • Integrated layout controls (Full width vs Boxed) and custom boxed width settings.
  • Optimized API communication with transient caching for improved admin performance.
  • Note: Basic functionality is completely free and requires no API key, ensuring full compliance with WordPress plugin directory guidelines.

1.0.2

  • Integrated foundational database infrastructure for consent logging and A/B testing.
  • Added automatic Cookie Policy Generator with GDPR and CCPA compliant templates.
  • Added Cookie Manager with automatic cookie scanning and categorization.
  • Added shortcodes for rendering cookie policies and cookie tables on the frontend.

1.0.1

  • Added Layout option to choose between Full Width and Boxed banner layouts.
  • Added Boxed Width setting to define the maximum width of the banner.
  • Supports CSS units such as px, %, em, rem, vw, and vh. Values without a unit are automatically treated as pixels (px).

1.0.0

  • Initial release
